terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Finora shows what public registers publish and what research agents find on the open web, with the source of every value. It is a research tool, not a credit report.
terms.blockedCredit: Credit decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedEmployment: Employment decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedInsurance: Insurance decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedTenancy: Tenancy decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedLicensing: Licensing decisions about a private individual or sole trader
terms.blockedServicing: Servicing or collecting credit about a private individual or sole trader
terms.purposeLine: Before details about the people of a company are shown, a purpose is asked for. The purpose is logged for each company opened.
terms.objectionLine: To object to a record about you, or to ask for it to be corrected or removed, use the report-a-problem form on that page.
terms.disclaimer: Not a credit report. Not for credit, employment, tenancy or insurance decisions.
terms.draft: These terms are a draft until a lawyer has reviewed them.
